announcement.quote: Invesco Closed-End Funds Announce Approval of Plan to Redeem Auction Rate Preferred Shares at Par and Approval of Fund Redomestications and Mergers

deals.notes: Roles inferred from the filing headers and the proxy registrants: the 2011-12-01 425 is FILED BY Invesco Quality Municipal Income Trust with SUBJECT COMPANY Invesco Quality Municipal Investment Trust, and the 2012 PRE 14A and DEF 14A name Quality Municipal Income Trust, Quality Municipal Investment Trust and Quality Municipal Securities together. The excerpts do not say which fund is the target or acquirer in words, and do not state any outcome. The N-14 excerpts say 'If shareholders of a Fund do not approve a Merger or if a Merger does not otherwise close, the Board will consider what additional action to take', which is generic.
